free_tier.stated: no free tier; the 1 GB standard plan is USD 2.99 a month with a 7-day money-back window

retention.stated: the VPS persists while paid; the page states a 7-day money-back policy and no deletion clock

egress.terms: unmetered fair share on a 1 Gbit/s network; no byte figure is published

interface_detail: root SSH and VNC console; a dedicated IPv4 and an IPv6 address are listed per plan
chaining: a dedicated-IPv4 VPS under USD 3 with an unmetered port, which a WireGuard node can use without any forwarding arrangement

limits.value: 1 Gbit/s, unmetered fair share; no published byte cap

binding_note: there is no byte quota, so the first real limit is the fair-share clause on a 1 Gbit/s port, whose enforcement threshold is unpublished.

identity_cost.detail: the pricing page states no identity gate; the order flow was not opened, so card versus PayPal and any hold are unverified.

reliability_note: no reliability event observed the vendor's promotional copy names hosting a personal VPN as a use of the plan
confidence_note: price, shape, address and bandwidth terms quoted from the pricing page read today; Servercheap rebranding is inferred from the redirect and not from a statement

evidence.proved: quoted plan: '1 GB RAM 2.99/mo - 1 GB Ram, 1 vCPU, 30 Ultra-Fast NVME Disk, 1 Gbit/s network, Unmetered fair share network, Linux OS of your choice, Root access via ssh and vnc, Dedicated IPv4 & IPv6 address'
quoted: 'VPS Hosting - A great place to start your website or blog, host your personal vpn, develop and test applications'

notes: The Servercheap name brief still resolves but no longer sells under its own domain: a request for servercheap.net returned cloudfanatic.net content with the title 'Affordable VPS Hosting Solutions for everyone'. Whether Cloudfanatic honours old Servercheap plans is not established. The 'unmetered' claim is fair-share, so a 24/7 tunnel at sustained rate is the case most likely to meet the unpublished threshold.

extras.price_arithmetic: USD 2.99 a month billed monthly; a VPS bills whether it runs, so 10 h/day and 24/7 are the same bill
extras.ipv6_prefix: an IPv6 address is listed per plan; no prefix width is stated
extras.renewal_note: no renewal price is published; the page states one monthly figure and does not mark it as a first-term promo
extras.payment_rails: Visa, MC, Amex, PayPal, wire; no hold stated
